ValidationRule.description: This validation rule will prevent South America users from saving records with the restricted picklist values while allowing North America users to proceed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(PMC_SS_IssueReason__c, 'Article request') || ISPICKVAL(PMC_SS_IssueReason__c , 'Data entry') || ISPICKVAL(PMC_SS_IssueReason__c, 'Planning') || ISPICKVAL(PMC_SS_IssueReason__c, 'Stock out / Plant outage'), TEXT($User.PMC_CPQ_SalesRegion__c) = 'Brazil')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This picklist value is not available for users in South America.
